english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something visually striking and attention-grabbing.
This is the all-purpose choice for something whose appearance makes a strong visual impression.
This is the all-purpose choice for something that stands out visually, whether attractively or conspicuously.
Use this for something that stands out visually, especially colours, designs, clothes, or signs.

examples.english: The colour of their new coat is striking; you notice it as soon as they walk in.
examples.traditional: 佢件新褸個顏色好搶眼，行入場即刻見到。

examples.english: This orange coat is really showy; you notice it as soon as you walk in.
